# Each string of the exported API of the three DSLs, with why it is a string.
# Format: entry<TAB>category<TAB>reason. TestStringsAreReviewed fails on a new
# string that is not here: make it a type, or add it with its reason.
# Categories: identity, free text, program, path pattern, fixture, boundary, checked.
